basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old guitarist living in Columbus, Ohio. I work as an industrial designer and spend my free time exploring different guitar sounds and setups. I’m relatively new to Reddit and enjoy learning from more experienced musicians. I tend to browse Reddit in the evenings after work, typically between 7 PM and 11 PM. I am single and enjoy attending live music events whenever possible. I appreciate straightforward advice and dislike overly technical jargon without practical application.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been playing guitar for about 5 years, mostly self-taught through online resources and YouTube tutorials. My knowledge about guitar amps is growing, and I enjoy experimenting with different sound profiles. My job as an industrial designer also gives me an edge in understanding the design and functionality aspects of musical equipment.
